subject: Vendor sourcing & cloud operational notice — new operator for EU compute
messages:
From: Ops Security <ops-security@bigretail.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.com>
Cc: CloudOps Vendor Onboarding <vendor-onboarding@cloudops.co>
Date: Sun, 30 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: vendor roster + operator change details for EU compute

Hi Sofia,

Quick note from the platform procurement/security side at Big Retail — we were notified that your EU compute operator for the Redwood hosted inference service is changing operator routing for a subset of instances to a third party (CloudOps) starting Q3. Before we progress to our formal procurement review, we need two things from Redwood:

1) An up-to-date vendor roster (CSV) listing all third-party operators, sub-vendors, and cloud operators that will have access to customer data or telemetry for EU regions. Please include contact, contracted services, and data residency notes.
2) A short operational change timeline (high level) and a brief attestation of controls the new operator maintains (network isolation, KMS integration, SOC2 type II or equivalent).

Can you turn this around by EOD June 3? Our internal legal/procurement window closes June 7 for the pilot scope.

If helpful, loop in your security/compliance contact — we will also share a short questionnaire (4–6 items) on access controls and logging.

Thanks,

--
Elena Morales
Senior Platform Security Manager
Big Retail Inc.
ops-security@bigretail.com

[Attachment: questionnaire-sample.pdf (PDF)]

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.com>
To: Ops Security <ops-security@bigretail.com>
Cc: CloudOps Vendor Onboarding <vendor-onboarding@cloudops.co>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 30 May 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: vendor roster + operator change details for EU compute

Hi Elena — thanks for the heads up and timeline.

We can provide the vendor roster and an operational timeline by June 3. Attached are: vendor-roster-v2.csv (complete roster with services and contact points) and cloudops-schedule.pdf (high-level rollout windows and migration staging).

High-level controls we can confirm for the CloudOps operator in EU:
- Dedicated tenant isolation for Redwood EU compute pools; no cross-tenant bursting into non-EU regions.
- KMS integration: CloudOps supports customer-managed keys via our KMS bridge; Redwood holds key access policy.
- Access logs: operator maintains immutable access logs; ingest into our central log store with 90-day primary retention and longer archival options.
- Auth: RBAC + mTLS for operator service-to-service comms; periodic key rotation.

Attestation documents (SOC2 / compliance artifacts) are typically shared under NDA; we can provide CloudOps' attestation as part of the security packet. Marissa / Rishi — can you validate the attached roster and attach the CloudOps attestation PDF (if available) so we can send one consolidated packet?

Elena — I also started the questionnaire you referenced; if you prefer, I can fill the short form directly and return it with the attachments.

Best,

Sofia Ivanova
Head of Partnerships — Redwood Inference
sofia@redwood.com
[Attachments: vendor-roster-v2.csv (CSV), cloudops-schedule.pdf (PDF)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 31 May 2027 08:21:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: vendor roster + operator change details for EU compute

On Sun, May 30, 2027 at 11:03 AM Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.com> wrote:
> Elena — thanks for the heads up and timeline.
> 
> We can provide the vendor roster and an operational timeline by June 3. Attached are: vendor-roster-v2.csv and cloudops-schedule.pdf.

Thanks, Sofia — I reviewed the roster quickly. A couple of asks before we send the packet:

- Please add a short note in the roster CSV for "operator access model" (API-only, console, or both) for every vendor row so procurement can triage (I added a column header but left the cells empty for CloudOps).
- Rishi — can you pull the latest CloudOps attestation and drop it here? If CloudOps doesn't publish SOC2 publicly, we need a signed attestation PDF and a primary contact for control testing requests.

Also, procurement will want to see a sample runbook excerpt for incident escalation to the operator (one page). If we have that internally, include it as cloudops-attestation.pdf (or call it runbook-excerpt.pdf) — whichever proc prefers.

I'll hold off sending the packet until we have that attestation and the completed column for operator access model. Timeline: still good to hit June 3 for initial packet, June 7 for review.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Director, Cloud Partnerships
marissa@redwood.com
Redwood Inference

From: Ops Security <ops-security@bigretail.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: CloudOps Sales <sales@cloudops.co>, vendor-onboarding@cloudops.co
Date: Wed, 02 Jun 2027 15:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: vendor roster + operator change details for EU compute

Hi Sofia / Marissa —

Thanks for the quick turnaround. We received the roster and schedule. A few next steps:

1) Please upload the completed roster CSV with the "operator access model" column populated and attach the CloudOps attestation PDF. Procurement needs the attestation to confirm control alignment.
2) We require a short (15–30 min) technical sync with your engineering/security team to validate the migration gates. Can you propose 2 slots next week?
3) We'll issue a one-page contract amendment for the operator change; please review and sign via DocuSign. I've attached the preliminary amendment link here: https://app.docusign.com/nextsteps/abcdef123456

If you can get steps 1–2 done by EOD June 6, we can keep to our internal schedule.

Regards,

Elena Morales
Senior Platform Security Manager
Big Retail Inc.
ops-security@bigretail.com

[Note: We will not accept attestation materials over public cloud storage without an existing NDA; please use the HubSpot/DocuSign links or provide a secure share link.]
